## Change request

Implements: CR-___ (issue #___)

## Type of change

- [ ] **Spec change**: `spec.md` and/or `api/openapi.yaml` change (label `spec-change`, needs spec-owner approval)
- [ ] **Implementation**: implements an already-approved spec; no spec files change
- [ ] **Implementation bug fix**: the spec was right, the code was wrong; adds a test that would have caught it

## Spec changes (if any)

- Feature: `specs/___/spec.md`
- Rules changed: R__
- `info.version`: ___ → ___ (patch: wording, minor: additive, major: breaking)
- [ ] Changelog row added to `spec.md`
- [ ] Rule tests updated together with the rules they encode
- [ ] Breaking changes: consumers listed in the issue have approved

## Checklist

- [ ] No gates were disabled or thresholds lowered
